data.name: Last Wish Introduction
data.short_summary:
—— The Guardian heads towards the Dreaming City.
Petra Venj: For generations, the Dreaming City housed one of the Awoken's most closely guarded secrets. She is known as Riven — Riven of a Thousand Voices. The last known Ahamkara. She has been Taken. And her death is your calling.
data.description:
** The Guardian heads towards the Dreaming City.

Petra Venj: For generations, the Dreaming City housed one of the Awoken's most closely guarded secrets. She is known as Riven — Riven of a Thousand Voices. The last known Ahamkara. She has been Taken. And her death is your calling.

categories.name: Ahamkara
categories.short_summary: A species first encountered by humans on Venus, said to resemble dragons, they were exterminated by order of the Tower.

categories.name: Petra Venj
categories.short_summary: The Queen’s Wrath who has also served as the Queen’s Emissary and Regent-Commander of the Reef.
